By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. **About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and quality-driven
**Lead Quality Analyst**
to lead quality assurance and testing activities for large-scale Salesforce-powered Enterprise Service Management (ESM), IT Service Management (ITSM), and Conversational Agentic Platform initiatives.
  
  
The Lead Quality Analyst will be responsible for defining quality strategy, governing testing practices, mentoring Quality Analysts, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet business, functional, security, integration, and user experience expectations.
  
  
This role requires a strong combination of quality leadership, business process understanding, stakeholder management, and hands-on testing expertise. The ideal candidate will work closely with Business Analysts, Architects, Salesforce Leads, Product Owners, and customer stakeholders to establish a quality-first culture across all delivery teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Leadership & Governance**

* Lead quality assurance activities across multiple Salesforce and ITSM workstreams.
* Define quality strategies, test governance processes, standards, and best practices.
* Establish testing frameworks, review processes, quality metrics, and release readiness criteria.
* Act as the primary quality escalation point for delivery teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across quality engineering practices.
* Ensure quality standards are consistently applied across all project phases.

**Test Strategy & Planning**

* Define comprehensive testing strategies covering:

+ Functional Testing
+ Integration Testing
+ End-to-End Testing
+ Regression Testing
+ User Acceptance Testing
+ Release Validation

* Review and approve test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test execution results.
* Ensure complete traceability between requirements and testing outcomes.
* Drive risk-based testing approaches for complex enterprise implementations.

**Salesforce & ITSM Solution Validation**

* Lead validation activities for solutions involving:

+ Salesforce Service Cloud
+ Experience Cloud
+ Agentforce
+ Enterprise Service Management
+ ITSM Platforms

* Validate business processes including:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Change Management
+ Problem Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management
+ Service Catalog Management
+ Employee Service Delivery

* Ensure solutions meet business objectives, customer requirements, and compliance expectations.

**Integration & Enterprise Testing**

* Lead testing of enterprise integrations involving Salesforce, MuleSoft, APIs, ERP, HR, Monitoring, and third-party applications.
* Establish integration testing standards and validation approaches.
* Ensure data integrity, synchronization, security, and business continuity across connected platforms.
* Oversee complex end-to-end business process validation.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Lead and mentor Quality Analysts across multiple projects.
* Review and approve testing deliverables.
* Provide coaching on testing methodologies, automation adoption, and quality best practices.
* Support capability development and certification initiatives.
* Foster a quality-first mindset across business and technical teams.

**UAT & Release Management**

* Guide UAT planning and business validation activities.
* Facilitate defect triage, prioritization, and resolution processes.
* Participate in release governance and production readiness reviews.
* Ensure quality criteria are achieved prior to production deployments.

**AI & Innovation**

* Define testing approaches for Agentforce, Conversational AI, and AI-powered service experiences.
* Validate intelligent workflows, autonomous service processes, and automation capabilities.
* Support adoption of quality engineering and test automation best practices.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 7–10 years of Quality Assurance and Testing experience in enterprise environments.
* Minimum 2–3 years leading QA teams or testing workstreams.
* Strong experience testing Salesforce and/or Enterprise Service Management platforms.
* Experience developing enterprise test strategies and governance frameworks.
* Deep understanding of:

+ Functional Testing
+ Integration Testing
+ End-to-End Testing
+ UAT
+ Defect Management
+ Quality Metrics
+ Root Cause Analysis

* Experience managing stakeholder expectations and quality reporting.
* Experience working within Agile, Scrum, and DevOps delivery models.
* Strong communication, leadership, and mentoring skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience testing Salesforce transformation programs.
* Experience validating ITSM, CMDB, or IT Asset Management implementations.
* Experience with API and MuleSoft integration testing.
* Exposure to automated testing frameworks and test automation strategies.
* Salesforce, ISTQB, Quality Engineering, or related certifications.

**Added Advantage**

* Experience testing Agentforce implementations.
* Exposure to Conversational AI and Generative AI platforms.
* Knowledge of Enterprise Service Management operating models.
* ITIL Foundation Certification.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are looking for professionals who:
  
  

* Think beyond defect identification and focus on business outcomes.
* Can lead quality governance across enterprise programs.
* Enjoy mentoring teams and driving continuous improvement.
* Have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Champion quality engineering and innovation.
* Are passionate about Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, and Enterprise Service Management.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead quality assurance efforts for strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational ITSM and Enterprise Service Management initiatives.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, MuleSoft, Salesforce, and Enterprise Automation platforms.
* Influence testing strategy, governance, and quality engineering practices across projects.

**LLM Fine-Tuning & Training Pipelines**

* Implement and maintain supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and RLHF pipelines for Cyncly domain-specific models, leveraging proprietary product catalogue, documentation, and support data.

* Maintain reproducible experiments, model versioning, and artefact management using MLflow or Weights & Biases; collaborate with Data Engineering to curate and version domain datasets with PII scrubbing and data-quality checks.

**Embeddings Infrastructure & Semantic Search**

* Develop and optimise embedding pipelines using models such as BGE-M3 and E5-large; manage vector database ingestion, indexing strategies, and retrieval quality for Cyncly's product catalogues and documentation.
* Design, benchmark, and maintain vector database deployments (Qdrant, Weaviate, or equivalent), including index configuration, filtering strategies, and scalability planning.

**RAG Architecture & Use Case Integration**

* Build and maintain the developer copilot integration using Continue.dev and custom language-server extensions; implement prompt injection defenses, output filtering, and guardrail layers across all inference paths.
